select d.trade_id as tradeId, /** 交易编号 **/ IFNULL(scp.FINPROD_ID, cp.finprod_id) as finprodId, /**子产品代码 - 产品代码 **/ IFNULL(scp.FINPROD_ID, cp.FINPROD_ABBR) as finprodAbbr, /**子产品简称 - 产品简称 **/ d.ps as psCode, /**交易类型Code - 交易方向**/ d.ps as ps, /** 交易类型Code - 交易方向 **/ d.CCY as ccyCode, /**币种Code**/ d.CCY as ccy, /**币种**/ d.SHARE_AMT as shareAmt, /**交易份额**/ d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, /**交易金额**/ (CASE WHEN instr('[C9],[C10],[T11],[T12];[C7],[T09],[T22]', concat_ws('', '[' , IFNULL(d.ps,'') ,']') ) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0) END) as prinAmt, /**交易本金-本金金额**/ d.INT_AMT as intAmt, /**红利利息金额-利息总额**/ (CASE WHEN instr('[C7]', concat_ws('', '[' , IFNULL(d.ps,'') ,']') ) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') END)as tradeDate, /**本金交易日**/ (CASE WHEN instr('[C9],[C10],[T11],[T12];[C7],[T09],[T22]', concat_ws('', '[' , IFNULL(d.ps,'') ,']') ) > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END) as settleDate /**红利利息支付日**/ from fin_product cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on ( cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id )
and d.finprod_type in ('F16','F18','F22','F26')
AND cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
AND d.settle_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
